title: Ecommerce Website for Sale in Dubai, UAE
tagline: Online D2C shapewear and anti-cellulite activewear business serving customers through a Shopify store. - The business operates on an asset-light, supplier-fulfilled model, with no physical retail, warehouse, or inventory storage requirements. - The business has 53,700+ lifetime customers and approximately 94,000 monthly unique visitors. - Customer acquisition is supported by Meta and Google advertising, with a reported 2.65x ROAS. - Operations cover product sourcing, supplier coordination, marketing, customer service, technology, and day-to-day e-commerce management. - The acquisition includes the brand, intellectual property, Shopify store, domain, customer database, supplier relationships, product catalogue, marketing creatives, advertising infrastructure, website content, and operating documentation. - The high revenue is supported by the asset-light dropshipping model, where suppliers handle fulfilment while the business focuses on marketing, operations, and customer service. - The existing team is available to remain post-acquisition, supporting continuity after the transaction. - The business has a trade license.
